current_report.note: Only the reported problem is visible at decision time. Later diagnosis and remedy are withheld.

record_availability_note: Earlier report dates precede the decision time, but the dataset does not establish when their retrospective narratives became available to an operator.

selection.rule: First two chronological manufacturer-1 reports with problem 'no heat' or 'not enough heat', outside substation 21 and on distinct substations, having >=100 prior-24-hour samples and nonempty required hc1 fields; selection fixed before model runs.
selection.cutoff: measurement timestamp <= report date; prior records strictly earlier
